memories.text: The owner's name is Samira and she goes by Sam.
Sam works from Lisbon, timezone Europe/Lisbon.
Sam drinks oat milk flat whites, never decaf.
Keep answers short: bullet points, no preamble.
Never force-push to main; open a merge request instead.
Run the unit tests before saying a change is done.
The bee-hive repository is hosted on GitLab under the platform group.
The staging server is staging.hive.internal and deploys from the release branch.
Production deploys happen on Tuesdays after the standup.
Code freeze for the Q4 launch starts on December 12.
The billing service stores invoices in Postgres 16.
Grafana dashboards for latency live at grafana.hive.internal/d/latency.
The on-call rota is in the PagerDuty schedule named hive-primary.
Sam has a dentist appointment every first Monday of the month.
Sam's cat is called Biscuit and is allergic to chicken.
Write code comments in English even when Sam writes in Portuguese.
Prefer TypeScript over JavaScript for new scripts.
The cloud budget for the hive project is 4000 euros per month.
Invoices from the hosting vendor arrive by email from billing@hoster.example.
Release notes are drafted in the shared Notion page called Changelog.
